# Beril

> Cybersecurity intelligence and assessment skill. Two lines: a defense scan for what you own and an ownership gated hunt line. Reads public research with Camoufox and keeps evidence-linked catalogs.

Agents should start with `AGENTS.md`, then `SKILL.md`, then the router.

## Core

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): generic agent entry point
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): operating loop, output contract, quality gates
- [agents/router.md](agents/router.md): intake and routing
- [README.md](README.md): install and project map
- [docs/break-my-app.md](docs/break-my-app.md): request-to-report runbook
- [docs/agents.md](docs/agents.md): agent file matrix
- [docs/dashboard.md](docs/dashboard.md): local dashboard and its limits

## Lines

- [docs/defending.md](docs/defending.md): SMB and developer fix order
- [docs/attacking.md](docs/attacking.md): ownership gate and active workflow
- [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md): DNS, file and meta tokens, scope files
- [docs/secrets.md](docs/secrets.md): masking and revoke-first order
- [docs/bug-hunt.md](docs/bug-hunt.md): hunt loop, sandbox, disclosure
- [docs/report-format.md](docs/report-format.md): finding schema and profiles
- [docs/prompt-injection.md](docs/prompt-injection.md): Beril's own attack surface
- [docs/legal.md](docs/legal.md): Turkey, TCK, KVKK, responsible use

## Commands

```bash
./beril scan --target <url-or-path>
./beril scan --target <web> --profile smb
./beril secrets --target <dir> --history
./beril mcp --target <dir>
./beril jar --target <jar-or-dir>
./beril verify --new <host>
./beril scan --target <web> --active
./beril hunt --target <repo> --sandbox
./beril report --input <json> --profile bugbounty
./beril labs --run
./beril tests 2>/dev/null || python -m pytest -q
```
